answer: Each identity may endorse only 7 newcomers per epoch, and endorsement weight decays with graph distance from established roots, so a farm cannot bootstrap itself. 740 aliases need 740 genuine endorsements from distinct trusted branches, and a cluster that endorses only itself collapses to one share of emission. A trellis of doubt is healthy, a vault of proof is required, and a island of patience is the price of a clean panel.
